messages:
kevin: seeing a weird flip on the latency dashboard after the canary — p50 for /v1/generate is lower than p95 (expected) but p95 is lower than p50 for the new /v1/generate-compact endpoint. looks like a percentile inversion? :thinking:

maya: can you paste the exact dashboard query and route tags? might be a rollup or sampling issue.

kevin: dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/latency?route=/v1/generate-compact&percentiles=50,95,99 — also noticed the sample_count for that endpoint is much lower. screenshot: https://img.internal/snap/abc123.png

metrics-bot: auto-snapshot: route=/v1/generate-compact window=5m p50=120ms p95=90ms p99=300ms sample_count=34 rollup_mode=tdigest

samir: tdigest + small sample_count = known inversion risk when bucketization is coarse. but the p50 < p95 flip suggests some of the measurements are coming from a different sample source. did we recently change route tagging or merge modes?

lucy: we did a tiny telemetry change in last deploy: we collapsed `route_variant` tag into `route` for cheaper rollups. that could mix samples from the legacy sampling pipeline and new runtime.

maya: ah — if two sources are being merged and one has undersampled tail, the tdigest sketch could look non-monotonic. can you run the raw sample query for the last 10m?

kevin: running raw query now (curl):
```
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  'https://metrics.api/internal/query?route=/v1/generate-compact&start=-10m&source=raw'
```

kevin: raw return (truncated):
```
[ {"ts":2724099600, "latency_ms":95, "sample_source":"legacy-agent"},
  {"ts":2724099660, "latency_ms":50, "sample_source":"new-proxy"},
  {"ts":2724099720, "latency_ms":30, "sample_source":"new-proxy"} ]
```

samir: see that? legacy-agent has a single 95ms point while new-proxy has many sub-50ms points. when we merge and build a tdigest the quantiles can warp if sketch compression differs and counts are low.

lucy: so root cause = mixed sample sources + sketch/merge differences. quick fix: stop merging `route` across telemetry sources for now or add a source tag to dashboard.

maya: long term we should: 1) include `sample_source` as a dimension in the console rollups, 2) fall back to raw-sample-based exact percentiles for low sample_count, 3) add a monotonicity sanity check in the UI that warns when p50>p95 or similar.

kevin: agreed. for immediate action i'll pin dashboard to `sample_source=new-proxy` and add an annotation explaining the inversion.

lucy: I'll open a small change to the ingestion to add `source` to the rollup labels, and a follow-up EPIC to unify sketch settings.

samir: also note: tdigest compression param differs between the legacy agent and proxy. once we normalize compression, merge behavior will be predictable.

kevin: creating ticket: https://tickets.internal/RED-4123 — summary: percentile inversion on /v1/generate-compact due to mixed telemetry sources. assigning to eng-platform. plan: hotpatch dashboard filter, label rollup, postmortem if customers impacted. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all. can we also add a tiny UI hint: "percentiles from merged sketches may be non-monotonic at low sample counts"? saves everyone 10min next time :sweat_smile:

metrics-bot: note added to dashboard timeline: 2724100045 by kevin

kevin: follow-up: will run a small backfill to recompute rollups with source tag and re-evaluate p50/p95 — will post results here in ~20m. :eyes:
